Expressions you need every day. Not grammar rules, not vocabulary lists. The real phrases that keep a conversation moving.

Daily prompts
One topic per day. Five minutes. Go.

Ten weeks, six days each. Every week has a grammar focus. Pick the day, use the starter, and talk with your buddy for 5 minutes. The goal is not to be perfect. The goal is to keep going.
